prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 90.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 86.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 32.4%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Pet Generation Waiting Tips Carousel', 'Interactive Pet Controls Guided Flow', 'Pet Care Mini Game Wait Flow', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Command Setup Flow', 'Desktop Rendering Progress and Audio Status Wait Info', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Voice & Speech Guided Flow', 'Custom Photo Lighting and Pose Preparation Hint', 'Clear Desktop Companion Mode Selection Value Copy', 'Compact Companion Path Choice Screen Redesign']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview', 'Sign-In Stalling Recovery Prompt', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Engaging Story Value Proposition Copy', 'Multi-Account Restore Sign-In Hint', 'Desktop Notification Toggle During Wait', 'Story Screen First Onboarding Reordering', 'Interactive Pet Personality & Customizer Stage', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Cheat-Sheet Wait Overlay', 'Split Account Continuity & Restore View', 'Desktop Companion Controls Walkthrough Screen', 'Custom Photo Selection Mascot Guidance', 'Sign-In Verification Desktop Alert', 'Instant Desktop Companion Value Copy', 'Animated Companion Teaser During Setup Wait', 'Post-Adoption Sign-In Step Reordering', 'Direct Photo Customization Value Headline Copy', 'Live Pet Activity Teaser Stream During Wait', 'Desktop Launch Ready Notification Switch', 'Account Data Preservation Incentive', 'Desktop Command Navigation Copy', 'Photo Customization Quality Tips Hint', 'Centered Path Selection Grid', 'Pick Friend Before Sign-In Sequence Shift', 'Adoption Character Stage Full Bleed Redesign', 'Desktop Audio Alert When Generation Completes', 'Companion Setup Status Monitor', 'Desktop Life Companion Onboarding Headline', 'Companion Mood and Voice Sound Test Flow', 'Multi-Device Pet Sync Sign-In Headline', 'Account Cloud Sync Status Verification Flow', 'Desktop Command Practice & Control Sandbox Screen', 'Desktop Readiness Audio Signal & Stage Monitor', 'Companion Path Compact Grid Selection Layout', 'Desktop Pet Care Companion Idle Activity Mini-Flow', 'Re-Sign-In Account Continuity & Pet Persistence Copy', 'Interactive Companion Hide and Summon Gesture Practice Flow', 'Account Pet Storage Persistence Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Confirmation Copy Update', 'Background Rendering Desktop Activity Hint']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Account Persistence Warning and Reset Prevention', 'Spotlight Adoption Certificate Redesign', 'Split Progress & Desktop Readiness Dashboard', 'Photo Formatting Guidelines Hint', 'Path Selection Bonus Badge', 'Desktop Readiness & Display Troubleshooting Guide', 'Desktop Quick Controls Sandbox Redesign', 'Generation Time Estimator & Visual Progress Hint', 'Onboarding Completion Starter Pack Badge', 'Account Sign-In Restore Explainer Redesign', 'Home Intro Desktop Checklist Redesign', 'Pet Naming and Personality Trait Selection Flow', 'Split Layout Home Intro Pet Command Summary', 'Early Adopter Pet Accessory Incentive Badge', 'Two-Column Path Comparison Cards Layout', 'Pick Friend Gallery Carousel Redesign', 'Account Sign-In Sequence Shift', 'Interactive Pet Controls Practice Playground Screen', 'Existing Account Restore Callout Hint', 'Companion Path Starter Toy Incentive', 'Generation Process Time Estimator Timer Display', 'Desktop Display Verification Step Screen', 'Two Column Pet Selector Layout', 'Stage Mode Path Selection Redesign', 'Photo Clarity Guidelines Callout', 'Account Sync Pet Recovery Hint', 'Welcome Starter Toy Unlocking Bonus', 'Story Scroll Path Selection Experience', 'Adoption Certificate First Sequence Shift', 'Custom Pet Accent Palette Unlock Incentive', 'Account Auth Method Continuity Hint', 'Adoption Certificate & Pet Trait Preview Redesign', 'Desktop Control Shortcuts Overview Card', 'Desktop Pet First Day Welcome Toy Incentive', 'Custom Pet Photo Crop and Alignment Adjuster Screen', 'Companion Path First Day Unlock Incentive']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several winning updates (such as copy, hint, and redesign changes) performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 3 of 5 tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, and +4.3%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +3.9%), while the remaining 5 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear positive effect was seen across tests for choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Feed and Care Practice Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive feeding and basic care sandbox flow on the home intro screen so users can practice feeding and interacting with their pet before completing setup.
candidates.why: Interactive finish flows performed strongly in past tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, +4.3%), and support emails report confusion about how to care for and interact with pets after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Practice Feeding and Caring for Your Companion
home_intro.body: Try giving your pet its first snack and interaction to see how it responds on your desktop.

candidates.title: Multi-Factor Account Security and Continuity Intro Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated onboarding screen prior to sign-in explaining how account authentication links pet save files permanently across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-signing in. Providing an explicit account continuity screen before sign-in sets clear expectations.

new_account_security.headline: Secure Your Pet Save Data
new_account_security.body: Signing in ensures your desktop companion, items, and settings are backed up to cloud storage automatically.
new_account_security.hint: Use your primary email to avoid duplicate empty accounts.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Audio and Animation Status Display
candidates.change: Adds real-time status indicators showing rendering progress, audio asset packing, and desktop display readiness on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait median time is 201s with long mean delays, and support emails mention pets failing to launch on desktop. Explaining exact generation steps lowers abandonment.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Sprite & Audio Assets
waiting.body: Optimizing companion movement animations and sound effects for your desktop environment.
waiting.hint: Your desktop companion will appear as soon as initialization completes.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Tray Navigation Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting the system tray icon controls and toggle shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish step has a long mean duration (5815s) and 3 support tickets asked how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion Controls
home_intro.body: Click your system tray icon to summon, hide, mute, or talk to your desktop companion at any time.

components.text:
Right-click tray icon to open quick menu
Press shortcut to hide or show pet instantly
Drag pet anywhere on desktop

candidates.title: Custom Photo Angle and Contrast Clarity Hint
candidates.change: Displays inline guidance on the upload photos screen suggesting front-facing angles and clear lighting for custom pet rendering.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 65.8% (mean 1017s) and support emails report custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.hint: For best pet generation, upload centered photos with good lighting and clear background contrast.

candidates.title: Cloud Account Pet Preservation Value Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in protects pet custom progress and prevents accidental account resets.
candidates.why: 8 users wrote support emails regarding missing pets after signing in. Clear sign-in copy reassures users about account pet safety.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect & Save Your Companion
sign_in.body: Link your account now to ensure your companion, accessories, and memory progress are safely stored in the cloud.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Interactive Sound & Visual Customizer Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive ambient sound and color preference selector while waiting for pet generation to complete.
candidates.why: Home wait step takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Giving users an interactive mini customizer during wait increases completion and reduces perceived wait time.

waiting.headline: Customize Ambient Sound & Desktop Lighting
waiting.body: Select your preferred ambient sound effects and light aura while your companion is being built.

components.text: Choose sound theme: Soft Chime, Nature Waves, Silent

candidates.title: Quick Desktop Control & Summon Keyboard Shortcuts Copy
candidates.change: Updates body and button copy on home intro to explicitly list key shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and moving the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report confusion post-onboarding regarding hiding or interacting with the pet.

home_intro.headline: You're All Set! Quick Desktop Commands
home_intro.body: Use Alt+P to summon or hide your pet. Right-click the pet for quick actions and settings anytime.

candidates.title: Character Adoption Certificate Seal Status Info
candidates.change: Adds verification status copy and processing visual indicator on the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet registration progress.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (65.8%). Clear certification progress details build trust before rendering starts.

adoption_certificate.hint: Registering companion license code and generating official adoption seal...

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Mode Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds dynamic hint copy on choose_path explaining how active vs quiet companion paths impact screen presence.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s), indicating users deliberate without clear guidance on what path options entail.

choose_path.hint: Active companion path offers regular chat prompts; Quiet companion path stays subtly docked until clicked.
